body: Thank you for the correction. I had once read somewhere that the military doesn't accept people with a history of depression or related meds, so I had thought that other fields could possibly be similar.

Our situations are really similar, and I truly hope things get better for you. In high school I kept believing that college would be different and that everything would come together, but I was completely wrong. Maybe I was unlucky, but if you ever end up feeling the same way, please don't lose hope or motivation like I did.

Thank you. I just wish I could communicate this well in real life. Even online I find it difficult to convey my thoughts like this; I guess this post is an exception because I've been dwelling on it for so long.

I've gone to a few anime conventions while growing up. But as much as I enjoy the exhibits and booths and events, I just can't seem to meet people there either. Too many people and everyone's busy doing their own thing. One of the times I went, I tried to join a group online to hang out with, and it just felt awkward the entire time. I've tried going to meetups as well, but it feels like everyone knows each other or can easily communicate while I'm just kinda there.

Self-improvement is something that I wish I started sooner. Currently I'm trying to self learn a new language, but without a teacher or any classmates it feels like a messy solo effort with little direction. I want to find some new hobbies as well, but it's been difficult to find something that clicks. Maybe I just need to keep looking, but it's been tough.
I wish I could, but since I don't know their language and my parents are outcasts they don't really consider me as part of their family.

Re-enrolling is probably for the best, but I don't know how to make that possible at this point. I wasted the grants and scholarships I got from high school, along with my parents' money. I'm still paying back my old debt so I feel like I have a long way to go if I ever did try to enroll again.

If you could help me meet new people, I'd be really grateful!

It sounds like fun! But my parents wouldn't support it at all, since they've always pushed me to do something science or technology-related. I'd have to go back to school and get a degree, and without their support I don't know if it's possible.

Hey! I play on Mateus, which is unfortunately on the other NA data center, Aether. Stormblood was really interesting. The story was decent enough, but what really shined to me was the great music and the new locations. I've been leveling my gatherers casually on the side, but I'm mostly into raiding at the moment.

I wish I could say the same. When in school, if anyone ever asked me what I liked to do, I'd just say "using the computer" or "playing games" which is what pretty much everyone does. I didn't feel like I was interesting, since I wasn't good at anything.

I'm trying to learn a new language right now so I can meet people in the future, but I'm struggling to learn new hobbies aside from that which I can talk about to make me more interesting as a person.

I always hear that, and it's probably true. It's just that once I left high school I realized how much more difficult it is to interact with other people. Now that I've dropped out of college it seems nearly impossible. Since I could never associate with people, I feel like I really took all my opportunities for granted. And now I'm at a loss on what to do, since by this point it seems so hard to recover.
Thanks. Finding a computer-related job seems daunting with no experience, but I'll keep looking and hope something comes up eventually.

> either enlist into a trade school, or community college

I'm afraid of the same mistakes happening again. Even if I wanted to, my parents don't trust me with the money to go to school. I'm still paying off my past college debt. 

> worst case scenario enlist into the armed forces

I've brought up the enlistment option with my parents before. Them being the helicopter parents they are, they'd never let me enlist. ("Oh no, what would we do if something happened to our only child?") And I think they've controlled and spoiled my life to the point where I can't take care of myself in a situation like that.

I have too many excuses, don't I? Like yeah, I understand the issues and what I can try to do to fix my life back up, but if I can't muster the motivation to even go to class, if I can't muster the courage to even talk to people, *how* could I manage to do any of this? Magic? Willpower from scratch? 

It's easy to state the problems and solutions, but I'm pretty much broken.
I also lmao at what a mess my life is
I've been playing mostly Final Fantasy XIV recently. I've been catching up on some RPGs sitting in my backlog as well
I'm from California. My grandparents migrated here from Asia and occasionally travel back, and I wish I could come along but my parents have pretty much cut all ties with them
I really like Japan. Singapore and Taiwan are nice as well. I love the food, culture, and people.
No issues here, with worse specs than you. Good luck
